criteria.criterion: a second, independently written materializer (different author or language) agrees with the reference model on the full convergence corpus including malformed and authorization-race cases
criteria.note: Rust materializer (different language; written from docs before the reference logic was read) converges on every delivery order and agrees with the reference on 90/115 cases; all 25 disagreeing cases are attributed (reference bugs REF-1/REF-3, doc ambiguities DA-1..DA-3). Partial because the reference covers only pins/redaction/polls/topics and needs an adapter-supplied authorization oracle, the doc ambiguities need rulings, and author independence is AI-to-AI (ADR-0117 proposed).

independence: Materializer written by a Claude agent in Rust from the public docs; its commit precedes reading the Python reference's logic. The design package was authored by a ChatGPT design agent and Claude agents; ADR-0117 (proposed) decides whether an AI reviewer/implementer counts as independent.

DA-1.description: state operation whose target is missing or of the wrong kind (pin/redact/vote/close/topic-move on a non-message, a never-arriving event, or a topic that never exists)

DA-2.description: duplicate topic.create for one TopicID: reference = latest create resets the topic; materializer = earliest create wins

DA-3.description: empty poll.vote selection: reference keeps an empty vote; materializer treats it as retraction

REF-1.description: equivocating duplicate EventID: reference keeps the last-arrived payload (order-dependent)

REF-3.description: poll.vote options are not validated against the poll (unknown option / multi-select on single-choice poll counted)
